plugin_asdk_app_6a3293e129088191abf08758.longDescription:
Create images, videos, branded content, and websites with Higgsfield in ChatGPT. Start with an idea, product photo, or reference image, then choose from Viral and Marketing Studio presets, creative recipes, or image and video models. Refine your results through conversation.

With Higgsfield, you can:

• Browse Viral presets with /effects and Marketing Studio presets with /product, /motion, or /marketing-studio. Explore creative recipes and named workflows such as /hero-shot, /reel-cover, and /genjutsu.

• Generate images and videos from text or reference images. Turn a product photo into image ads in different styles, short video ads with different hooks, or a complete set of promotional content.

• Create UGC product videos, reviews, unboxings, tutorials, fashion try-ons, faceless explainers, and episodes with a consistent AI presenter. Write scripts, generate narration, and add subtitles.

• Use Ad Multiplier to create targeted variations of an existing video, or edit footage with animated text, layouts, transitions, motion graphics, and effects.

• Build and deploy websites, web apps, and browser games. Refine the design and update your hosted project through chat.

Connect your Higgsfield account to get started.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3293e129088191abf08758.longDescriptionZh:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Higgsfield 创建图像、视频、品牌内容和网站。从想法、产品照片或参考图像开始，然后从 Viral 和 Marketing Studio 预设、创意配方或图像和视频模型中进行选择。通过对话完善您的结果。

通过希格斯菲尔德，您可以：

• 使用/effects 浏览Viral 预设，使用/product、/motion 或/marketing-studio 浏览Marketing Studio 预设。探索创意配方和命名工作流程，例如 /hero-shot、/reel-cover 和 /genjutsu。

• 从文本或参考图像生成图像和视频。将一张产品照片变成不同风格的图片广告、不同挂钩的短视频广告，或者是一整套的宣传内容。

• 使用一致的 AI 演示者创建 UGC 产品视频、评论、拆箱、教程、时尚试穿、匿名讲解员和剧集。编写脚本、生成旁白并添加字幕。

• 使用广告倍增器创建现有视频的有针对性的变体，或编辑带有动画文本、布局、过渡、动态图形和效果的素材。

• 构建和部署网站、Web 应用程序和浏览器游戏。通过聊天完善设计并更新您的托管项目。

连接您的 Higgsfield 帐户即可开始。

plugin_asdk_app_6a05e3b201788191be12b590.longDescription: Runway lets users generate and edit images, videos, and audio directly from ChatGPT using their Runway account. Users can create images from text or edit an uploaded photo, animate images into video, make targeted edits to existing footage, expand videos to new aspect ratios, build multi-shot story videos and product marketing ads, localize an existing ad into another language, remove backgrounds, upscale media, convert video to HDR, generate music, sound effects, and spoken voiceover, author and run saved Runway workflows, browse recent assets, and check remaining credits and plan. Users can share a video idea or source materials such as text, documents, PDFs, or URLs, and ChatGPT generates a script from that input. Users can open the generated project on Visla from the ChatGPT conversation to continue editing, export it, or download the final video. plugin_asdk_app_697b4f3e714c8191a274be3e.productIntro: 按个性、流派、用例、美学、行业发现字体，或直接从图像中识别字体。描述您的项目、心情、风格、创意方向或在聊天中上传图像，并获得符合您意图的精选字体推荐。
plugin_asdk_app_697b4f3e714c8191a274be3e.productIntroEn: Discover fonts by personality, genre, use case, aesthetics, industry — or identify fonts directly from an image. Describe your project, mood, style, creative direction or upload an image in chat and get curated font recommendations that match your intent.
plugin_asdk_app_697b4f3e714c8191a274be3e.longDescription:
Discover fonts by personality, genre, use case, aesthetics, industry — or identify fonts directly from an image. Describe your project, mood, style, creative direction or upload an image in chat and get curated font recommendations that match your intent.

1. Identify font from an image — Upload any image and get the matching fonts in seconds, powered by WhatTheFont.
2. Discover fonts by description — Describe your project's mood, style, industry, or vibe and get curated font recommendations that match.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke MyFonts directly with @MyFonts.
Try prompts like:
- @MyFonts Find me a serif that feels editorial and literary, but less traditional than Garamond or Baskerville.
- @MyFonts Recommend fonts for a campaign that should feel rebellious, youthful, and premium.
- @MyFonts identify the font used in the attached image.
- @MyFonts WhatTheFont used in the image.
- @MyFonts Suggest fonts for a boutique hotel identity inspired by old European signage, but updated for a contemporary luxury audience.
plugin_asdk_app_697b4f3e714c8191a274be3e.longDescriptionZh:
按个性、流派、用例、美学、行业发现字体，或直接从图像中识别字体。描述您的项目、心情、风格、创意方向或在聊天中上传图像，并获得符合您意图的精选字体推荐。

1. 从图像中识别字体 — 上传任何图像并在几秒钟内获得匹配的字体，由 WhatTheFont 提供支持。
2. 通过描述发现字体 — 描述您项目的氛围、风格、行业或氛围，并获得匹配的精选字体推荐。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2528e2c49c8191a8015ba5.name: Creative Claw
plugin_asdk_app_6a2528e2c49c8191a8015ba5.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中创建视频、产品广告、图像和配音。将照片制作成动画，将脚本变成多场景影片，或者制作带有旁白和字幕的创作者风格的产品广告。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2528e2c49c8191a8015ba5.productIntroEn: Create videos, product ads, images and voiceovers in ChatGPT. Animate a photo, turn a script into a multi-scene film, or make a creator-style product ad with narration and captions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2528e2c49c8191a8015ba5.longDescription:
Create videos, product ads, images and voiceovers in ChatGPT. Animate a photo, turn a script into a multi-scene film, or make a creator-style product ad with narration and captions.

Plan shots and storyboards, prepare consistent reference images, generate clips and assemble a first cut. Turn interviews and longer videos into social clips, cut and reorder selected moments, reframe for vertical formats, and add captions.

Create a reusable avatar from your photos or a fictional character brief. Review its character sheet, save it as a Character, and reuse its visual references in images and videos. Clone your own voice, or a speaker's voice with their explicit permission, from a clean recording. Save and reuse the clone with ElevenLabs or Cartesia, or choose a stock voice for multilingual narration. Generate music and sound effects for the same project.

Generate and edit supporting images, product photos and campaign visuals. Use reference images to guide product appearance, character identity, composition and style. Supported models include Seedance, Gemini Omni, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs and Cartesia; availability and settings vary.

Video Review mode shows the proposed prompt, references, settings and estimated credits before you press Generate. It reviews the request, not a rendered video preview. Auto mode submits the requested generation immediately. Generated storyboards and video drafts can also use credits.

Generation and editing use Creative Claw credits. Request an estimate before generating. Results, character consistency and voice similarity vary. Successfully generated playable videos are charged even when the result does not fully match your expectations. You can inspect balances and recent generation costs, or send feedback to help improve future results. For critical issues, contact support@creativeclaw.co.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2528e2c49c8191a8015ba5.longDescriptionZh:
在 ChatGPT 中创建视频、产品广告、图像和配音。将照片制作成动画，将脚本变成多场景影片，或者制作带有旁白和字幕的创作者风格的产品广告。

规划镜头和故事板，准备一致的参考图像，生成剪辑并组装初剪。将采访和较长的视频转变为社交剪辑，剪切和重新排序选定的时刻，重新构建垂直格式，并添加字幕。

根据您的照片或虚构人物简介创建可重复使用的头像。查看其角色表，将其另存为角色，并在图像和视频中重复使用其视觉参考。从干净的录音中克隆您自己的声音，或在获得明确许可的情况下克隆说话者的声音。使用 ElevenLabs 或 Cartesia 保存并重复使用克隆，或选择库存声音进行多语言旁白。为同一项目生成音乐和声音效果。

生成和编辑支持图像、产品照片和活动视觉效果。使用参考图像来指导产品外观、角色身份、构图和风格。支持的模型包括 Seedance、Gemini Omni、Nano Banana、ElevenLabs 和 Cartesia；可用性和设置有所不同。

在您按“生成”之前，视频审阅模式会显示建议的提示、参考、设置和估计的制作人员名单。它会审核请求，而不是渲染的视频预览。自动模式立即提交请求的生成。生成的故事板和视频草稿也可以使用制作人员名单。

生成和编辑使用 Creative Claw 积分。在生成之前请求估算。结果、字符一致性和声音相似度各不相同。即使结果不完全符合您的期望，成功生成的可播放视频也会收费。您可以检查余额和最近的发电成本，或发送反馈以帮助改善未来的结果。对于关键问题，请联系 support@creativeclaw.co。

plugin_asdk_app_69312da8e4dc81919370cb86.productIntro: Adobe 解锁了更多通过对话创建和完成工作的方式。 Adobe 连接器以前以 Photoshop 形式提供，现在为 Creative Cloud 和 Acrobat 提供创造力和生产力功能。描述您想要制作或更改的内容，Adobe 可以帮助您将想法、图像、视频和文档转化为精美的输出 - 从编辑照片和创建 PDF 到设计社交资产、调整视频大小、搜索 Creative Cloud 资产以及生成数据驱动的文档。 关键能力：
plugin_asdk_app_69312da8e4dc81919370cb86.productIntroEn: Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat.
plugin_asdk_app_69312da8e4dc81919370cb86.longDescription:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.
plugin_asdk_app_69312da8e4dc81919370cb86.longDescriptionZh:
Adobe 解锁了更多通过对话创建和完成工作的方式。 Adobe 连接器以前以 Photoshop 形式提供，现在为 Creative Cloud 和 Acrobat 提供创造力和生产力功能。描述您想要制作或更改的内容，Adobe 可以帮助您将想法、图像、视频和文档转化为精美的输出 - 从编辑照片和创建 PDF 到设计社交资产、调整视频大小、搜索 Creative Cloud 资产以及生成数据驱动的文档。
关键能力：

* 批量修饰肖像或编辑照片：放入照片并描述您想要的外观 - 调整颜色、光线和色调；消除干扰并产生新元素；应用 Lightroom 预设；删除背景；模糊、裁剪、调整大小和扩展图像。
* 从模板设计：从 Express 模板开始，更新文本和颜色，然后为社交媒体制作动画或转换为 PDF。
* 为任何平台优化视频：上传水平剪辑并要求重新格式化以适应 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 或任何平台。您还可以将剪辑拼接成单个序列。
* 搜索和组织创意作品：描述您正在寻找的内容，并按主题、风格、情绪或内容从您的 Creative Cloud 库中显示资源，而无需浏览文件夹。
* 处理 PDF 和文档：创建和转换精美的 PDF 和文档。
* 创建数据驱动文档：描述您的输出并提供您的数据 - 连接器将原始数据或内容转换为格式化的、可共享的 PDF，包括徽章、卡片、目录等。

您可以以访客身份开始，并使用 Adob​​e 帐户登录以获取更多功能和工具、Creative Cloud 存储以及跨会话保存的工作。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5563300db881918aa0eff3.name: WalkMyPlan — Floor Plans in 3D
plugin_asdk_app_6a5563300db881918aa0eff3.description: 通过聊天进行 3D 家居设计
plugin_asdk_app_6a5563300db881918aa0eff3.productIntro: 描述你想要的家——“一座 10 x 10 的房子，有一间主卧室和一间私人浴室、两间儿童房、一个开放式厨房和客厅、一个种有树木的花园”——WalkMyPlan 会一次性建造它：真实的墙壁、门、窗户、家具和花园。打开实时链接并以 3D 方式浏览它。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5563300db881918aa0eff3.productIntroEn: Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5563300db881918aa0eff3.longDescription:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload the real CAD file your architect sent — DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB — and WalkMyPlan converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model, so you start from reality instead of a blank page.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "walk me through it."
plugin_asdk_app_6a5563300db881918aa0eff3.longDescriptionZh:
描述你想要的家——“一座 10 x 10 的房子，有一间主卧室和一间私人浴室、两间儿童房、一个开放式厨房和客厅、一个种有树木的花园”——WalkMyPlan 会一次性建造它：真实的墙壁、门、窗户、家具和花园。打开实时链接并以 3D 方式浏览它。

继续在对话中进行设计。 “把客厅弄大一点。” “在北墙上放一台电视。” “我标记了 A 针——将前门准确地放在那里。”家具的放置是自动的——它会找到一个远离门口的空闲位置。每次编辑都会进入修订历史记录，您可以撤消或回滚到任何点。编辑用于可视化和规划； WalkMyPlan 不检查结构安全或建筑规范。

询问你建造了什么。 “厨房有多大？”、“小卧室可以放一张双人床吗？”答案是根据模型的真实几何形状测量的。

分享和协作。与指定的查看者或编辑者或通过链接私下共享计划。查看谁在何时更改了哪些内容。

已经有计划了吗？上传建筑师发送的真实 CAD 文件（DWG 或矢量 PDF，最大 100MB），WalkMyPlan 会将其转换为相同的可编辑、可步行的 3D 模型，因此您可以从现实开始，而不是从空白页面开始。

非常适合家居设计、室内设计、房间规划、翻新和规划建造。除非您共享，否则您的计划对您的帐户保密，永远不会用于训练 AI 模型，并且可以随时删除（垃圾保留它们可在 30 天内恢复）。

尝试：“给我建一栋带花园的三居室房子”，然后“带我参观一下它”。
defaultPrompts: Design a 120 m2 L-shaped house: bedrooms in one wing, living in the other, a covered patio in the corner. Give me the link.
Build a 10 by 10 meter house: master bedroom with private bathroom, two kids' rooms, a garden. Decorate it, give me the link.
Give me a link to upload my floor plan, then turn it into a walkable 3D model.
defaultPromptsZh: 设计一栋 120 平方米的 L 形房屋：一侧是卧室，另一侧是起居室，角落里有一个带顶棚的露台。给我链接。
建造一座 10 x 10 米的房子：带私人浴室的主卧室、两间儿童房、一个花园。装饰一下，给我链接。
给我一个上传平面图的链接，然后将其转换为可步行的 3D 模型。

plugin_asdk_app_6a60fb8e06048191b7bb1c7e.productIntro: 大多数创造性工作并不会止于第一代。 Morphix 涵盖了整个路径，从第一个提示到您实际移交的文件：一个信用池中的每个主要图像、视频和音频模型。
plugin_asdk_app_6a60fb8e06048191b7bb1c7e.productIntroEn: Most creative work does not stop at the first generation. Morphix covers the whole path, from the first prompt to the file you actually hand over: every major image, video, and audio model in one credit pool.
plugin_asdk_app_6a60fb8e06048191b7bb1c7e.longDescription:
Most creative work does not stop at the first generation. Morphix covers the whole path, from the first prompt to the file you actually hand over: every major image, video, and audio model in one credit pool.

Sign in with your Morphix account to get started.

With Morphix, you can:

• Generate. Images and video from text or from your own reference photos, including campaign stills, hero shots, posters, ad creatives and cinematic clips.

• Shoot. Product photography without a studio. Hero shots, lifestyle scenes, mockups, and as many variations as the campaign needs.

• Produce. Social and creator content, including thumbnails, UGC style product videos, faceless videos, reel covers.

• Render. Photorealistic visualization without a render farm. Sketches, plans, and models become images a client can sign off on.

• Finish. A retouch pass without a retoucher. Upscale to 4K with real detail, relight, clean up, recompose, and extend the frame.
plugin_asdk_app_6a60fb8e06048191b7bb1c7e.longDescriptionZh:
大多数创造性工作并不会止于第一代。 Morphix 涵盖了整个路径，从第一个提示到您实际移交的文件：一个信用池中的每个主要图像、视频和音频模型。

使用您的 Morphix 帐户登录即可开始。

使用 Morphix，您可以：

• 生成。来自文本或您自己的参考照片的图像和视频，包括活动剧照、英雄照片、海报、广告创意和电影剪辑。

• 射击。无需工作室的产品摄影。英雄镜头、生活场景、模型以及宣传活动所需的各种变化。

• 生产。社交和创作者内容，包括缩略图、UGC 风格的产品视频、匿名视频、卷轴封面。

• 使成为。无需渲染场即可实现逼真的可视化。草图、计划和模型成为客户可以签字的图像。

• 结束。无需修饰师的修饰通道。升级至 4K，具有真实的细节、重新照明、清理、重新构图和扩展帧。

Chat-to-Comic: Copy text conversations to instantly generate 4-panel manga skits. Ideal for social media content.
Smart Director Mode: Automatically structures stories with proper pacing (Intro, Build-up, Climax, Twist).
Mobile-First Format: Generates vertical scrolling layouts optimized for reading on smartphones.
Multi-Style Support: Switch between Shonen action, Korean Webtoon, and American Cartoon styles.

How to Use in ChatGPT

2. Trigger: Activate the app using one of these methods:
Type Commands: Simply type “@” then choose MangaBoom, or type “MangaBoom” in the chat box.
3. Create: That's it!

plugin_asdk_app_696e890a45388191b24c4a36.productIntroEn: Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.
plugin_asdk_app_696e890a45388191b24c4a36.longDescription:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let ChatGPT suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

ChatGPT can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines ChatGPT’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.

plugin_asdk_app_695d100ea2e881918c922c73.name: AI Color Picker - Design Tool
plugin_asdk_app_695d100ea2e881918c922c73.productIntro: 选择您喜欢的任何颜色并与 AI 讨论。
plugin_asdk_app_695d100ea2e881918c922c73.productIntroEn: Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI.
plugin_asdk_app_695d100ea2e881918c922c73.longDescription:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

以简单的方式了解色彩和谐。寻找突出的互补色。探索相邻的类似颜色。尝试三元色以获得俏皮的外观。从相同颜色的浅色和深色色调构建单色调色板。人工智能用简单的例子解释了每个想法。

探索颜色的含义。红色可以让人感到兴奋。蓝色可以让人感到平静。绿色可以让人想起自然。黄色给人明亮、欢快的感觉。紫色给人一种丰富或神奇的感觉。黑色给人一种大胆的感觉。白色给人干净的感觉。这些想法很常见，但它们不是规则。人工智能可以解释世界各地的不同观点。

正在进行设计？询问关于按钮、背景、文本、图标、图表、横幅或菜单的想法。打造品牌？探索徽标、产品、包装和营销的颜色。装修房间？比较油漆颜色并询问它们组合在一起看起来如何。挑衣服？询问哪种颜色适合服装。
如果您知道颜色代码，人工智能也可以提供帮助。讨论 HEX、RGB、HSL 和其他常见的颜色格式。询问屏幕上的颜色如何变化。了解亮度、饱和度和色调的工作原理。如果您对这些想法不熟悉，人工智能会用简单的语言解释它们。

可访问性很重要。询问阅读某种颜色的文字有多容易。了解为什么某些颜色对比其他颜色对更容易看到。为不同色觉的人探索更好的颜色选择。微小的改变可以使设计更易于每个人使用。

这个应用程序非常适合学生、教师、艺术家、设计师、开发人员、创作者、爱好者和任何喜欢色彩的人。您可以提出简单的问题或深入的问题。您可以探索一分钟或一小时。每次对话都从您选择的颜色开始。

也尝试有趣的游戏。让人工智能猜测一种颜色会让你想起什么。询问颜色琐事。筑起一道彩虹。寻找与季节相匹配的颜色。探索自然、太空、海洋、森林、花卉、食物、动物或著名艺术作品的色彩。以颜色为灵感编造故事，或为您最喜欢的颜色起个名字。

总有新的东西有待发现。每种颜色都有自己的故事。每一个微小的改变都会产生一个新的想法。选择一种颜色，提出问题，然后继续探索。无论您是想学习、创造、比较、想象，还是只是想玩转颜色，这个应用程序都能为您提供一种简单友好的方式，将每种颜色变成对话。

- Ask support questions using natural language.
- Learn and onboard to Autodesk products faster.
- Create a foundation for AI agents and automation.
- Available in 10 languages: English (United States), French (France), German (Germany), Spanish  (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Italian (Italy), Japanese (Japan), Korean (Korea), Chinese (Simplified), and Russian (Russia)

No special requirements.

About Autodesk

From the buildings we live and work in, to the cars we drive and the bridges we drive over. From the products we use and rely on, to the movies and games that inspire us. plugin_asdk_app_6a764f4cfd008191b7fe46c6.productIntro: Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions.用户可以通过描述所需的主题、视觉风格、构图、氛围、动作或其他创意细节，根据文本提示生成全新的图像和视频。
plugin_asdk_app_6a764f4cfd008191b7fe46c6.productIntroEn: Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.
plugin_asdk_app_6a764f4cfd008191b7fe46c6.longDescription:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities.

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. This allows users to initiate more complex video-generation tasks without requiring the entire generation process to be completed within a single interaction. After a video job has been submitted, users can retrieve its current generation status through ChatGPT, making it possible to check whether the video is still being processed, has been successfully completed, or requires further action.

Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within ChatGPT for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content. By continuously leveraging the latest available imaging and video technologies, Deep Art AI gives users access to modern, high-quality visual creation capabilities through simple conversational, prompt-based interactions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a764f4cfd008191b7fe46c6.longDescriptionZh:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions.用户可以通过描述所需的主题、视觉风格、构图、氛围、动作或其他创意细节，根据文本提示生成全新的图像和视频。

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available.底层的图像和视频功能不断保持更新，使用户可以受益于当前最先进的模型、改进的视觉质量、更准确的提示理解、更好的一致性、增强的真实感以及最新的创意生成功能。

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs.这允许用户启动更复杂的视频生成任务，而不需要在单次交互中完成整个生成过程。视频作业提交后，用户可以通过 ChatGPT 检索其当前生成状态，从而可以检查视频是否仍在处理、已成功完成或需要进一步操作。

plugin_asdk_app_6a605ef150fc819190b151f4.name: Font Pairing: Design & Brands
plugin_asdk_app_6a605ef150fc819190b151f4.description: 生成 UI 排版组合
plugin_asdk_app_6a605ef150fc819190b151f4.productIntro: 为设计师提供的 AI 字体配对。
plugin_asdk_app_6a605ef150fc819190b151f4.longDescription:
AI Font pairing for Designers.

Find beautiful font combinations in seconds with AI. Instead of trying dozens of fonts by hand, describe your project and get a complete font trio made for it. Each triplet includes a heading font, an accent font, and a body font that work well together. Whether you are building a website, designing a logo, creating a brand, making a presentation, or working on a social media post, this tool helps you choose fonts with less guesswork and more confidence.

Good typography can make a design feel clean, modern, friendly, bold, elegant, or playful. Picking the right fonts is often one of the hardest parts of design. Many fonts look great on their own but do not look good together. This app helps solve that problem. Tell the AI about your project, your audience, or the feeling you want, and it suggests font triplets that match your goals.

You can ask for styles like minimal, luxury, vintage, futuristic, editorial, corporate, creative, fun, classic, or high-tech. You can also describe your audience, your industry, or your brand personality. The AI uses your ideas to recommend fonts that fit the mood while keeping the design easy to read.

Every recommendation includes three fonts with different jobs. The heading font grabs attention. The accent font adds personality. The body font keeps long text clear and comfortable to read. Together they create a balanced typography system that is easier to use across websites, apps, presentations, posters, packaging, marketing materials, and more.

The app is useful for graphic designers, UI and UX designers, web designers, product designers, marketers, students, content creators, agencies, freelancers, startup founders, and anyone who wants better typography without spending hours testing font combinations.

You can keep asking for new ideas until you find the style you like. Try different moods, industries, audiences, or visual directions. Ask for alternatives, compare different looks, or explore fresh creative ideas. The AI can help you move from rough concepts to polished typography much faster than searching through large font libraries.

Whether you need fonts for a modern landing page, a restaurant menu, a fashion brand, a technology company, a portfolio, a mobile app, a book cover, a newsletter, or an event poster, the app helps you discover combinations that fit the project.

This tool works well during brainstorming, early design exploration, and final design decisions. It can help you avoid common pairing mistakes and give you inspiration when you feel stuck. It is also useful when you want to experiment with styles you might not have considered before.

If you already have one font picked, you can ask for matching options to complete the set. If you only know the feeling you want, the AI can start from that instead. The conversation is flexible, making it easy to refine results until they match your vision.

Instead of spending time comparing endless font lists, start with a strong typography system designed around your project. Save time, discover new ideas, and create designs with more consistency using AI-powered font triplets built for real design work.
plugin_asdk_app_6a605ef150fc819190b151f4.longDescriptionZh:
为设计师提供的 AI 字体配对。

利用 AI 在几秒钟内找到漂亮的字体组合。不要手动尝试数十种字体，而是描述您的项目并为其制作完整的字体三重奏。每个三元组包括标题字体、重音字体和正文字体，它们可以很好地配合使用。无论您是构建网站、设计徽标、创建品牌、进行演示还是撰写社交媒体帖子，此工具都可以帮助您减少猜测并更有信心地选择字体。

好的排版可以让设计给人干净、现代、友好、大胆、优雅或有趣的感觉。选择正确的字体通常是设计中最困难的部分之一。许多字体单独看起来很棒，但放在一起就不那么好看了。这个应用程序可以帮助解决这个问题。告诉人工智能你的项目、你的受众或你想要的感觉，它会建议符合你目标的字体三元组。

您可以要求简约、奢华、复古、未来、社论、企业、创意、有趣、经典或高科技等风格。您还可以描述您的受众、您的行业或您的品牌个性。人工智能会根据您的想法推荐适合您心情的字体，同时保持设计易于阅读。

每个推荐都包含三种具有不同用途的字体。标题字体引人注目。强调字体增添个性。正文字体使长文本清晰易读。他们共同创建了一个平衡的排版系统，更易于在网站、应用程序、演示文稿、海报、包装、营销材料等之间使用。

该应用程序对于图形设计师、UI 和 UX 设计师、网页设计师、产品设计师、营销人员、学生、内容创建者、机构、自由职业者、初创公司创始人以及任何想要更好的排版而不需要花费数小时测试字体组合的人来说非常有用。

你可以不断寻求新的想法，直到找到你喜欢的风格。尝试不同的情绪、行业、受众或视觉方向。寻求替代方案、比较不同的外观或探索新的创意。与搜索大型字体库相比，人工智能可以帮助您更快地从粗略的概念转变为精美的版式。

无论您需要现代登陆页面、餐厅菜单、时尚品牌、科技公司、作品集、移动应用程序、书籍封面、时事通讯还是活动海报的字体，该应用程序都可以帮助您发现适合项目的组合。
该工具在头脑风暴、早期设计探索和最终设计决策过程中效果很好。它可以帮助您避免常见的配对错误，并在您感到困难时为您提供灵感。当您想尝试以前可能没有考虑过的样式时，它也很有用。

如果您已经选择了一种字体，您可以要求匹配选项来完成该组字体。如果你只知道你想要的感觉，人工智能可以从那里开始。对话很灵活，可以轻松完善结果，直到它们符合您的愿景。

与其花时间比较无休止的字体列表，不如从围绕您的项目设计的强大的排版系统开始。使用专为实际设计工作构建的人工智能驱动的字体三元组，节省时间、发现新想法并创建更加一致的设计。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6375f9e5288191b1f6ad81.productIntro: Screel 在不离开聊天的情况下将一个想法变成了一个完成的视频。描述您想要的内容，Screel 会将项目构建为一系列场景：它编写故事板，为每个场景生成静态图像，并且可以将场景动画化为剪辑，添加 AI 配音旁白和背景音乐，并将所有内容渲染为可共享的视频。参考文档使您的角色、道具、产品和地点在各个场景中保持一致，无论它们是从上传的照片还是聊天中制作的图片开始。连续的场景可以相互衍生并使用结束帧进行动画处理，因此一个动作可以从一个剪辑流向另一个剪辑。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6375f9e5288191b1f6ad81.productIntroEn: Screel turns an idea into a finished video without leaving the chat. Describe what you want and Screel builds a project as a sequence of scenes: it writes the storyboard, generates a still image for every scene, and can animate scenes into clips, add AI voiceover narration and background music, and render everything into a shareable video.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6375f9e5288191b1f6ad81.longDescription: Screel turns an idea into a finished video without leaving the chat. Describe what you want and Screel builds a project as a sequence of scenes: it writes the storyboard, generates a still image for every scene, and can animate scenes into clips, add AI voiceover narration and background music, and render everything into a shareable video. Reference documents keep your characters, props, products and places consistent from scene to scene, whether they start from an uploaded photo or a picture made in the chat. Consecutive scenes can be derived from one another and animated with an end frame, so one action flows from clip to clip. Clips are generated at a low-cost draft resolution by default, with higher tiers available when you ask. Live widgets show the storyboard, job progress and the final player inline, and every project stays open in the Screel web app for timeline trimming, document editing and collaboration.

plugin_asdk_app_6a97af93ebc88191961039f1.productIntroEn: ImagineArt turns a written brief into finished creative, images, video, music, logos, ads and social posts, without leaving the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a97af93ebc88191961039f1.longDescription:
ImagineArt turns a written brief into finished creative, images, video,
music, logos, ads and social posts, without leaving the chat.

Describe what you want and it generates it: a product ad, a fashion
photoshoot, an Instagram post, a YouTube thumbnail, an interior design
render, a logo animation, or a background track. You can also work on
images you already have, remove a background, upscale, apply effects,
or re-edit an earlier generation.

For teams doing repeat work, it keeps reusable pieces in your workspace:
products, presenter avatars, fashion models, outfits and shot settings,
so later shoots stay consistent with earlier ones. Everything is saved
into your ImagineArt folders and stays available after the conversation.

Requires an ImagineArt account. Generations use your plan's credits.
plugin_asdk_app_6a97af93ebc88191961039f1.longDescriptionZh:
ImagineArt 将书面简报转化为成品创意、图像、视频、
音乐、徽标、广告和社交帖子，无需离开聊天室。

描述你想要什么，它就会生成它：产品广告、时尚
照片拍摄、Instagram 帖子、YouTube 缩略图、室内设计
渲染、徽标动画或背景轨道。您还可以从事
您已有的图像，删除背景，高档，应用效果，
或重新编辑较早的一代。

对于进行重复工作的团队，它会在您的工作空间中保留可重复使用的部分：
产品、主持人头像、时装模特、服装和拍摄设置，
所以后来的拍摄与早期的拍摄保持一致。一切都已保存
进入您的 ImagineArt 文件夹并在对话后保持可用。

需要 ImagineArt 帐户。几代人都使用您计划的积分。

Kopi generates responsive HTML suitable for Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and other email platforms that accept HTML, optimized for Shopify brands.

Provide a brand URL (optional) and a campaign goal (e.g., “15% off”, “new product launch”, “gift guide”) to create an email for your brand.

plugin_asdk_app_6948cdcd2ad8819196c54ca8.name: Whiteboard by Athena AI
plugin_asdk_app_6948cdcd2ad8819196c54ca8.productIntro: Whiteboard by Athena AI（Athenaboard）是一款人工智能原生协作白板，可以实时生成并与您的团队共享人工智能内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6948cdcd2ad8819196c54ca8.productIntroEn: Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.
plugin_asdk_app_6948cdcd2ad8819196c54ca8.longDescription:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly
plugin_asdk_app_6948cdcd2ad8819196c54ca8.longDescriptionZh:
Whiteboard by Athena AI（Athenaboard）是一款人工智能原生协作白板，可以实时生成并与您的团队共享人工智能内容。  

如何开始
- 简单描述您想要的内容（例如，“移动应用程序的线框图”、“创建用户登录流程图”、“显示二次公式”、“生成日落图像”）
- 应用程序将自动使用适当的工具来呈现您的请求
- 使用“添加到白板”保存任何可视化供以后使用

核心特点
1.图表可视化
   - 直接在 ChatGPT 中渲染复杂图表，包括：流程图、序列图、类图、状态图、ER 图、甘特图、饼图、思维导图、时间线等
   - 由 Mermaid.js 提供支持，可提供精美的交互式图表
   - 图表可以复制或添加到您的白板上

2. 线框推荐
   - 与您的团队实时集思广益 UI/UX 设计
   - 超过 10,000 个可编辑模板供 AI 挑选
   - 获取按钮、卡片、导航元素、表单等设计组件。
   - 支持移动、网络、桌面和平板电脑平台

3. 协作白板
   - 将任何可视化（图表、线框图、图像、LaTeX 公式）添加到实时协作白板
   - 与您的团队实时协作
   - 持久存储 - 您的白板已保存并可随时访问
   - 每个用户都有一个在对话中持续存在的活动板

4.LaTeX 可视化
   - 在 ChatGPT 中渲染复杂的科学公式和数学方程
   - 支持内联方程、完整文档和化学符号
   - 使用 KaTeX 和完整的 LaTeX 编译进行精美的排版

5. 生成图像并打印在产品上
   - 根据各种风格的文本描述生成AI图像（写实、艺术、卡通、素描、抽象）
   - 创建和购买定制产品：T 恤、马克杯、连帽衫和枕头
   - 产品通过Printify创建，可以直接购买

plugin_asdk_app_6a563ea6fb7c819199eab25c.productIntro: HookLayer 帮助创作者、营销人员和机构分析 Instagram、TikTok 和 YouTube 帐户。它会审核账户表现，寻找表现出色的视频，识别重复出现的亮点和病毒式传播模式，对内容创意进行评分，并将经过验证的格式转化为原创的亮点、脚本和准备拍摄的概念。使用它来了解什么是有效的、为什么有效以及下一步要创建什么。

It audits account performance, finds high-performing videos, identifies recurring hooks and viral patterns, scores content ideas, and turns proven formats into original hooks, scripts, and ready-to-film concepts. Use it to understand what is working, why it works, and what to create next.

plugin_asdk_app_69a1cf9421d081919ce806c9.name: DepositPhotos
plugin_asdk_app_69a1cf9421d081919ce806c9.productIntro: 让我们一起创造精彩的事物！
plugin_asdk_app_69a1cf9421d081919ce806c9.longDescription:
Let’s create awesome things together!

Our mission is to help you push your ideas forward, which is why we are building our creative ecosystem. We strive to develop products with AI technology, a user-first approach, and creative freedom. With our stock content library and online tools, creators can realize all kinds of projects - whether they're bold, funny, experimental, or game-changing. We welcome diverse ideas and are always looking to help you carry them out.

Depositphotos brings a world-class stock library into your ChatGPT workflow. Search over 250M+ royalty-free photos, vectors, videos, and music, refine results with natural language, and browse clean previews - all without leaving the conversation.

Use it to quickly find the right visuals for presentations, marketing materials, social posts, websites, and product mockups. When you spot the perfect asset, open the canonical Depositphotos page to review licensing and download options in your Depositphotos account.

Built for speed, clarity, and creative momentum - so you can move from idea to usable content in minutes.
plugin_asdk_app_69a1cf9421d081919ce806c9.longDescriptionZh:
让我们一起创造精彩的事物！

我们的使命是帮助您推动您的想法，这就是我们构建创意生态系统的原因。我们致力于利用人工智能技术、用户至上和创意自由来开发产品。借助我们的库存内容库和在线工具，创作者可以实现各种类型的项目 - 无论它们是大胆的、有趣的、实验性的还是改变游戏规则的。我们欢迎不同的想法，并始终寻求帮助您实现这些想法。

Depositphotos 将世界一流的库存库带入您的 ChatGPT 工作流程。搜索超过 2.5 亿张免版税照片、矢量图、视频和音乐，使用自然语言优化结果，并浏览干净的预览 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。

使用它可以快速找到适合演示文稿、营销材料、社交帖子、网站和产品模型的视觉效果。当您发现完美的资源时，请打开规范的 Depositphotos 页面以查看您的Depositphotos 帐户中的许可和下载选项。

专为速度、清晰度和创意动力而打造 - 因此您可以在几分钟内从想法转变为可用的内容。

It combines a research-first design skill with read-only MCP tools for searching curated visual styles, real product screens, and complete user flows.
plugin_asdk_app_6a72258e6f18819183e5c4d8.longDescription: Refero helps AI agents research strong, real-world interface references before designing or implementing a product. It combines a research-first design skill with read-only MCP tools for searching curated visual styles, real product screens, and complete user flows. plugin_asdk_app_695ab324dd4c8191b76be9a4.longDescription:
Create freely. Calculate confidently.

Soapmaking depends on getting the numbers right. When the math is off, the whole batch is off. Simple SoapCalc takes care of the calculations so you can focus on the craft, not the chemistry.

Describe the soap you want to make. Adjust oils, batch size, or superfat as you explore. Simple SoapCalc responds with precise lye, water, and oil amounts you can trust, every time.

Try asking:
• I want to make a creamy, moisturizing soap for dry winter skin
• Create a beginner-friendly recipe with olive oil, coconut oil, and shea butter (500 g total)
• What kind of soap produces lots of fluffy lather?

You’ll see clear results right away, along with an honest sense of how the soap will behave and feel. Creativity stays open. The calculations stay exact.

No spreadsheets. No second-guessing.
Just safe, well-made soap — calculated in seconds.
plugin_asdk_app_695ab324dd4c8191b76be9a4.longDescriptionZh:
自由创作。自信地计算。

肥皂制作取决于正确的数字。当数学结束时，整个批次就结束了。 Simple SoapCalc 负责计算，因此您可以专注于工艺，而不是化学。

描述一下你想要制作的肥皂。在探索过程中调整油、批量大小或超级脂肪。 Simple SoapCalc 每次都会以值得信赖的精确碱液、水和油量进行响应。

尝试询问：
• 我想制作一款适合冬季干燥皮肤的奶油状保湿皂
• 使用橄榄油、椰子油和乳木果油（共 500 克）制作适合初学者的食谱
• 哪种肥皂能产生大量蓬松的泡沫？

您会立即看到清晰的结果，并诚实地了解肥皂的行为和感觉。创造力保持开放。计算保持准确。

没有电子表格。没有事后猜测。
只是安全、制作精良的肥皂——以秒计算。

plugin_asdk_app_6a610f58f8348191bf98761a.name: Gradient Maker - Linear Color
plugin_asdk_app_6a610f58f8348191bf98761a.productIntro: 用简单的英语创建美丽的颜色渐变。
plugin_asdk_app_6a610f58f8348191bf98761a.productIntroEn: Create beautiful color gradients with plain English.
plugin_asdk_app_6a610f58f8348191bf98761a.longDescription:
Create beautiful color gradients with plain English.

This GPT helps you design, improve, explore, and refine gradients for websites, apps, logos, presentations, social posts, games, illustrations, and anything else that uses color. You do not need to know color theory or CSS. Just describe what you want, and it will help you create gradients that fit your idea.

You can ask for soft, bold, bright, dark, warm, cool, modern, vintage, playful, elegant, natural, futuristic, or minimal styles. You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

You can ask for things like:

• A sunset gradient for a landing page.
• A modern blue gradient for a SaaS product.
• A calm background for a meditation app.
• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.
• A pastel gradient for invitations.
• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.
• A hero section gradient.
• A gradient based on your company colors.

If you are building a website, the GPT can suggest gradients that feel clean, readable, and professional. If you are making an app, it can recommend combinations that support the style you want. If you are creating marketing graphics, it can generate eye-catching backgrounds without overwhelming your content.

It can also explain why certain colors work together, how warm and cool colors change the mood, and how contrast affects readability. The explanations are simple enough for beginners while still being useful for experienced creators.

Need inspiration? Ask for dozens of ideas. Want something unique? Ask for unexpected combinations. Want something safe? Ask for classic choices. The GPT adapts to your goals instead of giving the same answers every time.

You can refine results by saying things like “make it brighter,” “less purple,” “more premium,” “more playful,” “higher contrast,” “better for dark mode,” or “closer to nature.” Each request builds on the last so you can quickly explore different directions.

Developers can ask for CSS gradients or color values. Designers can focus on appearance. Beginners can simply describe what they imagine without worrying about technical details.

This GPT works well for websites, mobile apps, dashboards, presentations, posters, logos, illustrations, social media graphics, game interfaces, email banners, portfolios, branding, product mockups, wallpapers, and digital art.

Whether you need one quick gradient or want to explore many creative directions, this GPT helps you move from idea to polished result in minutes. Describe the feeling, purpose, audience, or colors you have in mind, and receive thoughtful gradient suggestions that are easy to understand, easy to refine, and ready to use in your next project.
plugin_asdk_app_6a610f58f8348191bf98761a.longDescriptionZh:
用简单的英语创建美丽的颜色渐变。

此 GPT 可帮助您设计、改进、探索和细化网站、应用程序、徽标、演示文稿、社交帖子、游戏、插图和其他使用颜色的任何内容的渐变。您不需要了解颜色理论或 CSS。只需描述您想要什么，它将帮助您创建适合您想法的渐变。

您可以要求柔和、大胆、明亮、深色、温暖、酷炫、现代、复古、俏皮、优雅、自然、未来或简约风格。你可以从一种颜色、两种颜色、一种心情、一个品牌，甚至一个简单的句子开始。 GPT 将您的想法转化为均衡的渐变建议，并以清晰、简单的语言解释了它们为何有效。

它可以创建线性、放射状和其他常见的渐变样式。如果您已经有了颜色，它可以改进它们。如果您只有一个想法，它可以从头开始建议颜色。如果感觉有些“不对劲”，它可以建议一些小的改变，使整个设计看起来更好。

此 GPT 对于设计师、开发人员、营销人员、学生、创作者、爱好者以及任何想要获得更好看的颜色而不需要花费数小时进行实验的人来说非常有用。

您可以询问以下事项：

• 着陆页的日落渐变。
• SaaS 产品的现代蓝色渐变。
• 冥想应用程序的平静背景。
• 丰富多彩的游戏主题。
• 奢华的黑色和金色外观。
• 邀请函的柔和渐变。
• 受自然启发的调色板。
• 深色模式背景。
• 英雄部分渐变。
• 基于您公司颜色的渐变。

如果您正在构建网站，GPT 可以建议让人感觉干净、可读且专业的渐变。如果您正在制作应用程序，它可以推荐支持您想要的风格的组合。如果您正在创建营销图形，它可以生成引人注目的背景，而不会压倒您的内容。

它还可以解释为什么某些颜色可以协同工作，暖色和冷色如何改变情绪，以及对比度如何影响可读性。这些解释对于初学者来说足够简单，同时对于经验丰富的创作者来说仍然有用。

需要灵感吗？询问数十个想法。想要一些独特的东西吗？寻求意想不到的组合。想要安全的东西吗？询问经典选择。 GPT 会适应您的目标，而不是每次都给出相同的答案。
你可以通过说“让它更亮”、“更少的紫色”、“更优质”、“更有趣”、“更高的对比度”、“更适合黑暗模式”或“更接近自然”等来细化结果。每个请求都建立在上一个请求的基础上，因此您可以快速探索不同的方向。

开发人员可以请求 CSS 渐变或颜色值。设计师可以专注于外观。初学者可以简单地描述他们的想象，而不必担心技术细节。

该 GPT 非常适合网站、移动应用程序、仪表板、演示文稿、海报、徽标、插图、社交媒体图形、游戏界面、电子邮件横幅、作品集、品牌、产品模型、壁纸和数字艺术。

无论您需要一个快速渐变还是想要探索许多创意方向，此 GPT 都可以帮助您在几分钟内从想法转变为完美的结果。描述您心目中的感觉、目的、受众或颜色，并获得深思熟虑的渐变建议，这些建议易于理解、易于改进，并可在您的下一个项目中使用。

plugin_asdk_app_698d462b7cdc81919f262bb8.description: 立即通过聊天功能构建网站
plugin_asdk_app_698d462b7cdc81919f262bb8.productIntro: Dazzly 是一款一体化网站构建器，可帮助小型企业和创建者快速在线建立专业网站，而无需将托管、安全性、设计工具和附加组件拼接在一起。
plugin_asdk_app_698d462b7cdc81919f262bb8.productIntroEn: Dazzly is an all‑in‑one website builder that helps small businesses and creators get a professional site online quickly—without stitching together hosting, security, design tools, and add‑ons.
plugin_asdk_app_698d462b7cdc81919f262bb8.longDescription:
Dazzly is an all‑in‑one website builder that helps small businesses and creators get a professional site online quickly—without stitching together hosting, security, design tools, and add‑ons.

Start from polished templates and customize your pages while Dazzly handles the technical essentials in the background: website hosting, free SSL security, and performance-focused image optimization so your site loads smoothly across devices.

Need content fast? Dazzly includes access to stock image/video/icon libraries to help you publish with less time spent searching and buying assets.

If you sell products, Dazzly’s built‑in ecommerce shopping cart lets you take payments and offer options like click & collect, delivery, or cash on pickup—so your website can support real day‑to‑day sales, not just look good.

For teams who want strong foundations without endless setup, Dazzly also includes built‑in SEO and performance fundamentals (like sitemaps and structured data) to help your site be discoverable and dependable from day one.
plugin_asdk_app_698d462b7cdc81919f262bb8.longDescriptionZh:
Dazzly 是一款一体化网站构建器，可帮助小型企业和创建者快速在线建立专业网站，而无需将托管、安全性、设计工具和附加组件拼接在一起。

从精美的模板开始，自定义您的页面，而 Dazzly 在后台处理技术要点：网站托管、免费 SSL 安全性和以性能为中心的图像优化，以便您的网站可以跨设备顺利加载。

需要快速内容吗？ Dazzly 包含对库存图像/视频/图标库的访问，可帮助您以更少的时间搜索和购买资源进行发布。

如果您销售产品，Dazzly 的内置电子商务购物车可让您接受付款并提供点击提货、送货或提货现金等选项，这样您的网站就可以支持真正的日常销售，而不仅仅是看起来不错。

对于想要坚实的基础而不需要无休止的设置的团队来说，Dazzly 还包括内置的 SEO 和性能基础知识（例如站点地图和结构化数据），以帮助您的网站从第一天起就易于发现且可靠。

plugin_asdk_app_69458f632eb08191bae869ab.productIntro: 您的下一次练习需要节拍器吗？只需描述您的需求，Subdivide 就会在您的对话中构建它。
plugin_asdk_app_69458f632eb08191bae869ab.productIntroEn: Need a metronome for your next practice session? Just describe what you need and Subdivide builds it right in your conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_69458f632eb08191bae869ab.longDescription:
Need a metronome for your next practice session? Just describe what you need and Subdivide builds it right in your conversation.

With Subdivide you can:
• Create metronomes at any tempo from 10-400 BPM
• Use complex time signatures like 7/8, 5/4, or 6/8
• Add subdivisions from eighth notes to septuplets
• Mute individual subdivisions to practice complex rhythms
• Build click tracks with multiple sections and tempo transitions

Perfect for rehearsals, recording sessions, or live performance prep.
plugin_asdk_app_69458f632eb08191bae869ab.longDescriptionZh:
您的下一次练习需要节拍器吗？只需描述您的需求，Subdivide 就会在您的对话中构建它。

通过细分，您可以：
• 以 10-400 BPM 的任意速度创建节拍器
• 使用复杂的拍号，如 7/8、5/4 或 6/8
• 添加从八分音符到七连音的细分
• 将各个细分静音以练习复杂的节奏
• 构建具有多个部分和速度过渡的节拍音轨

非常适合排练、录音或现场表演准备。
defaultPrompts: Create a metronome at 120 BPM with eighth notes
Make a click track that starts at 120 BPM and transitions up to 280

plugin_asdk_app_69463c3af6a48191aef5c210.productIntroEn: Make A Viz app in ChatGPT lets you create and edit visual diagrams—flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and mind maps—directly inside ChatGPT. Diagrams are generated instantly within ChatGPT, with no external tools or tabs required.
plugin_asdk_app_69463c3af6a48191aef5c210.longDescription:
Make A Viz app in ChatGPT lets you create and edit visual diagrams—flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and mind maps—directly inside ChatGPT.
Diagrams are generated instantly within ChatGPT, with no external tools or tabs required. You can ask for things like “create a flowchart for our sales approval process” or “build a sequence diagram for user authentication,” and see the diagram rendered inline.
Diagrams are fully editable through conversation and a visual editor. You can refine them by sending instructions such as “add an error-handling branch” or by directly adjusting nodes and connections.
All diagrams are saved automatically and remain accessible inside ChatGPT. You can retrieve and continue editing them later by asking “list my diagrams” or “show the onboarding flow I created.”
plugin_asdk_app_69463c3af6a48191aef5c210.longDescriptionZh:
ChatGPT 中的 Make A Viz 应用程序可让您直接在 ChatGPT 内创建和编辑可视化图表（流程图、序列图和思维导图）。
图表在 ChatGPT 内立即生成，无需外部工具或选项卡。您可以询问“为我们的销售审批流程创建流程图”或“为用户身份验证构建序列图”之类的内容，并查看内联呈现的图表。
图表可以通过对话和可视化编辑器完全编辑。您可以通过发送“添加错误处理分支”等指令或直接调整节点和连接来完善它们。
所有图表都会自动保存并在 ChatGPT 内保持可访问性。您可以稍后通过询问“列出我的图表”或“显示我创建的入门流程”来检索并继续编辑它们。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9fb9b1df58819183cf4681.productIntro: TopView 可帮助您使用 Agent 创建和管理可视化项目。使用领先的 AI 模型生成图像和视频，在画布中组织角色、产品、场景、参考和版本，并且无需在工具之间移动资产即可继续工作。 使用 TopView，您可以： • 在一处生成和编辑图像和视频。从文本、参考、现有资产或代理上下文创建。 • 让项目资产在画布中井井有条。管理角色、产品、场景、故事板、参考和生成的结果。随着项目的发展，资产和版本保持连接。 • 将代理指令与直接编辑相结合。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fb9b1df58819183cf4681.productIntroEn: TopView helps you create and manage visual projects with your Agent. Generate images and videos with leading AI models, organize characters, products, scenes, references, and versions in canvas, and keep working without moving assets between tools. With TopView, you can: • Generate and edit images and videos in one place. Create from text, references, existing assets, or Agent context.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fb9b1df58819183cf4681.longDescription:
TopView helps you create and manage visual projects with your Agent. Generate images and videos with leading AI models, organize characters, products, scenes, references, and versions in canvas, and keep working without moving assets between tools.
With TopView, you can:
• Generate and edit images and videos in one place. Create from text, references, existing assets, or Agent context.
• Keep project assets organized in canvas. Manage characters, products, scenes, storyboards, references, and generated results. Assets and versions stay connected as your project evolves.
• Combine Agent instructions with direct editing. Let your Agent handle planning and multi-step tasks, then review, reorder, compare, replace, and refine results directly in canvas.
• Create films and short dramas. Develop stories, characters, worlds, storyboards, shots, and timelines with Film and Drama Skills.
• Turn research and data into marketing creative. Use product information, audience insights, competitor analysis, reviews, and ad trends to create concepts, UGC videos, product videos, and campaign assets.
• Remake and adapt videos. Analyze references, reuse their structure or style, and recreate them with your own products, characters, or assets.
Work with your Agent from planning and research to visual creation, editing, and final delivery — while keeping the whole project connected in canvas.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fb9b1df58819183cf4681.longDescriptionZh:
TopView 可帮助您使用 Agent 创建和管理可视化项目。使用领先的 AI 模型生成图像和视频，在画布中组织角色、产品、场景、参考和版本，并且无需在工具之间移动资产即可继续工作。
使用 TopView，您可以：
• 在一处生成和编辑图像和视频。从文本、参考、现有资产或代理上下文创建。
• 让项目资产在画布中井井有条。管理角色、产品、场景、故事板、参考和生成的结果。随着项目的发展，资产和版本保持连接。
• 将代理指令与直接编辑相结合。让您的代理处理规划和多步骤任务，然后直接在画布中查看、重新排序、比较、替换和优化结果。
• 创作电影和短片。利用电影和戏剧技能开发故事、角色、世界、故事板、镜头和时间表。
• 将研究和数据转化为营销创意。使用产品信息、受众洞察、竞争对手分析、评论和广告趋势来创建概念、UGC 视频、产品视频和营销活动资产。
• 重新制作和改编视频。分析参考文献，重用其结构或风格，并使用您自己的产品、角色或资产重新创建它们。
与您的代理合作，从规划和研究到视觉创作、编辑和最终交付，同时保持整个项目在画布中的连接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.name: Pexafy
plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.description: 查找免费使用的库存照片
plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.productIntro: Pexafy 搜索照片的方式就像向某人描述照片一样。
plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.productIntroEn: Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.
plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.longDescription:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.longDescriptionZh:
Pexafy 搜索照片的方式就像向某人描述照片一样。

要求“有人深夜在安静的公寓里独自工作，只有灯光照亮
温暖的台灯”，你会得到与场景相符的照片——而不是照片
标有这些词。搜索同时运行九个免费许可源
（Unsplash、Pexels、Pixabay、Kaboompics、Burst、StockSnap、Picjumbo、Skitterphoto、
NegativeSpace），而不是一次只提供一个提供者。

三个工具，均为只读：

search_photos — 用句子描述场景，可以选择按颜色过滤，
方向、来源、许可证、摄影师或日期。

search_photos_by_image — 提供参考图像并获得视觉相似度
照片，可选择调整文字：“像这样，但在晚上”。

get_similar_photos — 更多类似已找到的照片，这就是您的方式
使整套文章或套牌在视觉上保持一致。

每个结果都带有要显示的信用额度、多种尺寸的图像，以及
它的尺寸、主色、方向、来源和许可。结果是
编号，这样你就可以像在谈话中那样引用照片——
“更像第三个”——而不是复制标识符。

在呈现 MCP 应用程序的客户端中，结果显示为缩略图网格内
对话，单击其中一个即可打开其完整元数据，无需再次调用。

连接器已托管，因此无需安装任何内容，也无需粘贴 API 密钥
进入配置文件：您在浏览器中登录 Pexafy 一次，然后
连接器接收自己的凭据，与您的密码分开并且可撤销
靠它自己。它仅被授予读取访问权限，并且不会要求更多权限。

免费的 Pexafy 帐户每月可覆盖 5,000 次搜索，无需银行卡。
defaultPrompts: Find photos of the exact moment a wave crashes into jagged coastal rocks.
Find photos of asymmetric architecture, then more like the third one.
Photos of hands kneading dough on a floured wooden table, warm and close up.
defaultPromptsZh: 查找海浪撞击锯齿状海岸岩石的确切瞬间的照片。
查找不对称建筑的照片，然后更像第三张。
照片中，手在撒了面粉的木桌上揉面团，温暖而特写。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5f6cd1de288191a59184a2.productIntro: 海报制作器可帮助您将您的想法变成专业海报，而无需离开聊天室。 只需描述您需要的内容 - 生日邀请、餐厅优惠、节日问候、商业促销、活动传单或社交媒体帖子 - 海报制作工具就会搜索其模板库以找到最匹配的设计。它直接在 ChatGPT 中显示个性化预览，而不是通用示例。 添加名称、日期、价格、折扣、联系电话或业务信息等详细信息，海报制作工具会自动将您的内容放入选定的设计中，以便您可以看到最终海报的外观。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5f6cd1de288191a59184a2.productIntroEn: Poster Maker helps you turn your ideas into professional posters without leaving the chat. Simply describe what you need—a birthday invitation, restaurant offer, festival greeting, business promotion, event flyer, or social media post—and Poster Maker searches its template library to find the best matching designs.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5f6cd1de288191a59184a2.longDescription:
Poster Maker helps you turn your ideas into professional posters without leaving the chat.
Simply describe what you need—a birthday invitation, restaurant offer, festival greeting, business promotion, event flyer, or social media post—and Poster Maker searches its template library to find the best matching designs. It displays personalized previews directly in ChatGPT instead of generic samples.
Add details such as a name, date, price, discount, contact number, or business information, and Poster Maker automatically places your content into the selected design so you can see how the final poster will look.
Once you've found the design you like, open it in the Poster App Lab editor to customize colors, fonts, images, and layout, then download and share your finished poster anywhere.

海报制作器可帮助您将您的想法变成专业海报，而无需离开聊天室。

plugin_asdk_app_6a673b3d27848191af9b47a6.longDescription:
The PostNitro MCP server lets AI assistants and agents — Claude (Desktop, Code, and Cowork), Cursor, ChatGPT, and any other Model Context Protocol  client — create carousels and image posts, manage brand kits and connected social accounts, and schedule posts directly.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae345f2dc8191bd52864d.description: 文本转语音和文字记录
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae345f2dc8191bd52864d.productIntro: VoiceLabs 是一个基于浏览器的语音工作室，用于文本转语音和转录。 VoiceLabs 插件可让 ChatGPT 直接使用您的语音库：列出您帐户上的语音配置文件、在缺少语音时提供内置预设语音、从文本生成语音音频、将音频剪辑转录为文本、浏览您保存的捕获以及检查您之前开始生成的一代的状态。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae345f2dc8191bd52864d.productIntroEn: VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you start…
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae345f2dc8191bd52864d.longDescription:
VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you started earlier.

Access is granted through OAuth 2.1 with a consent screen that shows exactly which scopes you are approving: voice:read for browsing your library, voice:generate for producing audio and transcripts. You can revoke a connection at any time from Connected Apps in the VoiceLabs app, which invalidates both the stored consent and any live access tokens. Voice cloning is deliberately excluded from this surface. The plugin can only provision VoiceLabs' own preset voices, because uploading samples of a real person's voice requires a consent an agent cannot hold on your behalf.

Generated audio is returned as a short-lived signed link rather than a permanent public URL, and every tool call is recorded on the account's audit trail with its outcome.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae345f2dc8191bd52864d.longDescriptionZh:
VoiceLabs 是一个基于浏览器的语音工作室，用于文本转语音和转录。 VoiceLabs 插件可让 ChatGPT 直接使用您的语音库：列出您帐户上的语音配置文件、在缺少语音时提供内置预设语音、从文本生成语音音频、将音频剪辑转录为文本、浏览您保存的捕获以及检查您之前开始生成的一代的状态。

访问权限是通过 OAuth 2.1 授予的，并有一个同意屏幕，该屏幕准确显示您正在批准的范围：voice:read 用于浏览您的库，voice:generate 用于生成音频和文字记录。您可以随时从 VoiceLabs 应用程序中的连接应用程序撤销连接，这会使存储的同意和任何实时访问令牌失效。声音克隆被刻意排除在这个表面之外。该插件只能提供 VoiceLabs 自己的预设语音，因为上传真人语音样本需要获得代理的同意，而代理无法代表您获得同意。

生成的音频作为短暂的签名链接而不是永久的公共 URL 返回，并且每个工具调用及其结果都记录在帐户的审计跟踪中。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9a9af423b0819195523f55.productIntro: SSHOW 是一种设计工具，其中一个画布可以容纳您的布局、其运动以及 你从中给出的演示。连接这个插件，你的助手就可以在里面工作 您已经在 SSHOW 编辑器中打开的项目：它读取场景并 对象，添加或更改文本、形状、图像和关键帧，并采取 截图来检查自己的工作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a9af423b0819195523f55.productIntroEn: SSHOW is a design tool where one canvas holds your layout, its motion, and the presentation you give from it. Connect this plugin and your assistant works inside the project you already have open in a SSHOW editor: it reads the scenes and objects, adds or changes text, shapes, images and keyframes, and takes a screenshot to check its own work.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a9af423b0819195523f55.longDescription:
SSHOW is a design tool where one canvas holds your layout, its motion, and the
presentation you give from it. Connect this plugin and your assistant works inside
the project you already have open in a SSHOW editor: it reads the scenes and
objects, adds or changes text, shapes, images and keyframes, and takes a
screenshot to check its own work.

Everything happens in the project on your screen, so you watch each change land. A
batch of edits arrives as a single undo step, and the assistant can undo or redo it
for you. Nothing runs when you have no editor open.

You need a free SSHOW account and a project open at s.show or in the desktop app.
You sign in once when you connect, and you can end the connection at any time from
your profile.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a9af423b0819195523f55.longDescriptionZh:
SSHOW 是一种设计工具，其中一个画布可以容纳您的布局、其运动以及
你从中给出的演示。连接这个插件，你的助手就可以在里面工作
您已经在 SSHOW 编辑器中打开的项目：它读取场景并
对象，添加或更改文本、形状、图像和关键帧，并采取
截图来检查自己的工作。

一切都发生在屏幕上的项目中，因此您可以观看每一次土地的变化。一个
批量编辑作为单个撤消步骤到达，助手可以撤消或重做它
为了你。当您没有打开编辑器时，什么也不会运行。

您需要一个免费的 SSHOW 帐户和一个在 s.show 或桌面应用程序中打开的项目。
连接时登录一次，您可以随时结束连接
你的个人资料。

Point it at a drawing URL or paste DXF text to read title blocks and dimension values, check layer structure, and visually inspect floor plans, die-cut layouts, and mechanical parts without leaving the conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.name: kernelCAD
plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.description: 简单英语到 CAD 模型
plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.productIntro: kernelCAD 将自然语言描述转化为真实的参数化 CAD 模型。请求零件、支架、外壳或机构，kernelCAD 会编写由真正的 BREP 内核 (OpenCascade) 支持的可编辑 .kcad.ts 源代码，然后让您检查拓扑、运行设计检查（干扰、可制造性、可达性、负载）并导出到 STEP/STL。每个模型都会在对话中的交互式 3D 查看器中打开，因此您可以旋转、缩放和查看零件，而无需离开 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.productIntroEn: kernelCAD turns natural-language descriptions into real, parametric CAD models. Ask for a part, bracket, enclosure, or mechanism and kernelCAD writes editable .kcad.ts source backed by a true BREP kernel (OpenCascade), then lets you inspect topology, run design checks (interference, manufacturability, reachability, load), and export to STEP/STL.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.longDescription: kernelCAD turns natural-language descriptions into real, parametric CAD models. Ask for a part, bracket, enclosure, or mechanism and kernelCAD writes editable .kcad.ts source backed by a true BREP kernel (OpenCascade), then lets you inspect topology, run design checks (interference, manufacturability, reachability, load), and export to STEP/STL. Every model opens in an interactive 3D viewer right inside the conversation, so you can rotate, zoom, and review the part without leaving ChatGPT. Unlike a text-to-image tool, kernelCAD produces engineering-grade geometry with named faces and edges, parametric features, assemblies with mates and joints, and validation gates that catch broken or non-manufacturable models before you build.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.longDescriptionZh: kernelCAD 将自然语言描述转化为真实的参数化 CAD 模型。请求零件、支架、外壳或机构，kernelCAD 会编写由真正的 BREP 内核 (OpenCascade) 支持的可编辑 .kcad.ts 源代码，然后让您检查拓扑、运行设计检查（干扰、可制造性、可达性、负载）并导出到 STEP/STL。每个模型都会在对话中的交互式 3D 查看器中打开，因此您可以旋转、缩放和查看零件，而无需离开 ChatGPT。与文本到图像工具不同，kernelCAD 可以生成工程级几何体，其中包含命名面和边、参数化特征、带有配合和接头的装配体，以​​及在构建之前捕获损坏或不可制造模型的验证门。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9c2a3d40448191b3a20a26.longDescription:

plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.description: 使用 AI 创建和编辑视频
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.originalDescription: Create and edit videos with AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.productIntro: 使用您的 VideoGen 帐户从 ChatGPT 创建专业、可编辑的视频和媒体。随时在 videogen.io 上完善项目。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.productIntroEn: Create professional, editable videos and media from ChatGPT with your VideoGen account. Refine projects anytime on videogen.io.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.longDescription:
Create professional, editable videos and media from ChatGPT with your VideoGen account. Refine projects anytime on videogen.io.

Workflows: turn a narration script, uploaded voiceover, PDF/slideshow, or scene-by-scene storyboard into a multi-scene video with AI visuals and captions. Or generate a single prompt-to-clip when you only need a short shot.

Media tools: create images, video clips, voiceovers, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and talking-head avatars; upscale, vectorize, remove backgrounds, or add 3D parallax to stills. Upload brand assets (logos, product shots, audio) with the in-chat uploader when ChatGPT supports it.

Edit and deliver: remix projects (captions, transitions, animate stills), export MP4 downloads, and open deep links back into the VideoGen app for timeline edits, team settings, and finer control. Generation uses your VideoGen team credits; if a feature isn't available on your account, open app.videogen.io and manage your VideoGen account, then retry.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.longDescriptionZh:
使用您的 VideoGen 帐户从 ChatGPT 创建专业、可编辑的视频和媒体。随时在 videogen.io 上完善项目。

工作流程：将旁白脚本、上传的画外音、PDF/幻灯片或逐个场景的故事板转换为具有 AI 视觉效果和字幕的多场景视频。或者当您只需要短镜头时生成单个剪辑提示。

媒体工具：创建图像、视频剪辑、画外音、音乐、音效、动态图形和头像；升级、矢量化、删除背景或向静态照片添加 3D 视差。当 ChatGPT 支持时，使用聊天内上传器上传品牌资产（徽标、产品图片、音频）。

编辑和交付：重新混合项目（字幕、转场、动画剧照）、导出 MP4 下载以及打开深层链接返回 VideoGen 应用程序以进行时间线编辑、团队设置和更精细的控制。 Generation 使用您的 VideoGen 团队积分；如果您的帐户无法使用某项功能，请打开 app.videogen.io 并管理您的 VideoGen 帐户，然后重试。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3b65deef9881919825c50e.productIntro: PosterMyWall 将设计模板带入您的聊天中。描述您需要什么 - 盛大的开业传单、迎婴派对邀请函、乐队徽标、Instagram 促销帖子；并浏览对话中出现的模板选项。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3b65deef9881919825c50e.productIntroEn: PosterMyWall brings design templates into your chat. Describe what you need - a grand opening flyer, a baby shower invitation, a band logo, an Instagram sale post; and browse template options that appear right in the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3b65deef9881919825c50e.longDescription:
PosterMyWall brings design templates into your chat. Describe what you need - a grand opening flyer, a baby shower invitation, a band logo, an Instagram sale post; and browse template options that appear right in the conversation.

What you can do
- Describe the design you're looking for in plain language.
- Include details like size, colors, style, or theme, and the results will match them.
- Browse the template options that appear in the chat.
- Open any template on PosterMyWall to customize it.

Designs for everything
Flyers, invitations, logos, posters, social media posts, menus, and more for small businesses, events, churches, schools, and organizations of every kind.

Customizing your template
This plugin finds and displays templates; editing happens on PosterMyWall. Every template preview includes an "Open in PosterMyWall" button that opens the template's page in a new tab, where you can edit it in PosterMyWall's drag-and-drop editor - swap text and images, resize for other platforms, and download.

Try prompts like
- Find me a grand opening flyer for a coffee shop.
- Show me baby shower invitations in soft pastels.
- I need a square Instagram post for a 50% off weekend sale.
- Find a grunge logo for a rock band.

Requirements: No account is needed to open a template. A free PosterMyWall account is required to save or download your design. Every template has a free download option; high-resolution downloads are paid.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3b65deef9881919825c50e.longDescriptionZh:
PosterMyWall 将设计模板带入您的聊天中。描述您需要什么 - 盛大的开业传单、迎婴派对邀请函、乐队徽标、Instagram 促销帖子；并浏览对话中出现的模板选项。

你能做什么
- 用简单的语言描述您正在寻找的设计。
- 包括尺寸、颜色、样式或主题等详细信息，结果将与它们相匹配。
- 浏览聊天中显示的模板选项。
- 打开 PosterMyWall 上的任何模板进行自定义。

适合一切的设计
适用于小型企业、活动、教堂、学校和各种组织的传单、邀请函、徽标、海报、社交媒体帖子、菜单等。

自定义您的模板
该插件查找并显示模板；编辑发生在 PosterMyWall 上。每个模板预览都包含一个“在 PosterMyWall 中打开”按钮，该按钮可在新选项卡中打开模板页面，您可以在 PosterMyWall 的拖放编辑器中对其进行编辑 - 交换文本和图像、调整其他平台的大小以及下载。

尝试类似的提示
- 给我找一张咖啡店开业传单。
- 给我看看柔和的迎婴派对请柬。
- 我需要一个方形的 Instagram 帖子以获得周末 50% 的折扣。
- 寻找摇滚乐队的垃圾标志。

要求：无需帐户即可打开模板。需要一个免费的 PosterMyWall 帐户才能保存或下载您的设计。每个模板都有免费下载选项；高分辨率下载是付费的。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7be9a728448191adb2f3be.name: Drivethrough
plugin_asdk_app_6a7be9a728448191adb2f3be.productIntro: 描述您想要的网站，几秒钟内即可上线。无需代码，无需设置，无需学习网站构建器 - 您说出您想要的内容，ChatGPT 构建它，Drivethrough 将其放到网上。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7be9a728448191adb2f3be.productIntroEn: Describe the website you want, and it's live in seconds. No code, no settings, no website builder to learn - you say what you want, ChatGPT builds it, and Drivethrough puts it online.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7be9a728448191adb2f3be.longDescription:
Describe the website you want, and it's live in seconds. No code, no settings, no website builder to learn - you say what you want, ChatGPT builds it, and Drivethrough puts it online.

Every site starts private, visible only to you. Share it like a doc link - send it to exactly the people you choose, no accounts needed - or make it public for the world when you're ready. That makes Drivethrough good for two kinds of sites: the little ones that were never for the whole internet (trip plans, the family recipe book, a tool that splits the bills), and the public ones you've been meaning to make (the plumbing business, the band, the bake sale).

Changing a site is just asking again. Every change is saved, so you can roll back to any earlier version instantly. Forms and RSVPs land in your email. Public sites can use your own web address, and it's free to start.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7be9a728448191adb2f3be.longDescriptionZh:
描述您想要的网站，几秒钟内即可上线。无需代码，无需设置，无需学习网站构建器 - 您说出您想要的内容，ChatGPT 构建它，Drivethrough 将其放到网上。

每个站点都是私有的，只有您可见。像文档链接一样共享它 - 将其发送给您选择的人，无需帐户 - 或者在您准备好时将其公开给全世界。这使得得来速适合两种类型的网站：那些从来不适合整个互联网的小网站（旅行计划、家庭食谱、分摊账单的工具），以及你一直想做的公共网站（管道业务、乐队、烘焙义卖）。

换个网站只是再问一次。每个更改都会保存，因此您可以立即回滚到任何早期版本。表格和回复会发送到您的电子邮件中。公共站点可以使用您自己的网址，并且可以免费启动。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6c6ebc8f74819197497c77.productIntro: Synthesia 可以将您正在制作的任何内容转变为成品的品牌视频。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c6ebc8f74819197497c77.productIntroEn: Synthesia turns whatever you're working on into a finished, on-brand video.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c6ebc8f74819197497c77.longDescription:
Synthesia turns whatever you're working on into a finished, on-brand video.

Start from a prompt, a script, a document, or a link. We build a multi-scene video draft using your workspace's brand kits or one our curated Styles. Choose your Style or brand kit in the chat, open the draft in Synthesia to edit, or just generate and watch the video directly in the chat.

Already have the source material somewhere else? Pull it from the tools you're connected to and hand it straight to us — no copy-paste, no rebuilding.

You can ask Synthesia to:

"Make a video explaining our new expense policy."
"Turn this brief into a two-minute video for new starters."
"Take the notes from our product spec and make an internal launch video."
"Pull this quarter's numbers and make a 90-second update for the team."
"Find the onboarding video we published last quarter."
"Summarize what shipped this week and turn it into a video for the sales team."
"Show me my drafts."

Requirements: a paid Synthesia account. Connect once and we'll use your existing brand settings and workspace permissions — you'll only ever see videos you already have access to in Synthesia.

Want to go hands-on? Every draft or generated video can be opened in Synthesia's full editor for editing and polish.

This plugin is currently in beta and features may be added or removed in the future, and there may be bugs. Please report any bugs, feedback, or issues you experience at https://synthesiacreate.typeform.com/mcp-beta and/or support@synthesia.io

其他地方已经有源材料了吗？从您连接的工具中提取它并直接交给我们 - 无需复制粘贴，无需重建。

您可以要求 Synthesia ：

plugin_asdk_app_6aa28e5a079c81919a66c838.productIntro: ShotClick 是一个剧本编辑器：专业格式化、锁定场景编号、修订通道、制作细目以及 .fdx 导入和导出。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28e5a079c81919a66c838.productIntroEn: ShotClick is a screenplay editor: professional formatting, locked scene numbers, revision passes, production breakdown, and .fdx import and export.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28e5a079c81919a66c838.longDescription:
ShotClick is a screenplay editor: professional formatting, locked scene numbers, revision passes, production breakdown, and .fdx import and export.

This plugin lets ChatGPT work inside the script itself instead of returning loose text. It reads your projects, scenes, subject, treatment, outline, characters, research notes and comments, and writes back properly formatted scenes, loglines, treatments and outline beats. Your existing permissions apply: on a shared project, a viewer stays read-only through the plugin too.

It can open a "what if" branch from any scene, so an alternate version of the story is written in parallel without touching the original. It also reaches AI Studio, the screenplay-to-video pipeline: it looks at the generated keyframes and reference images, then writes the image and video prompts that match them.

No tool deletes anything — not a scene, not a project, not a note — and no tool spends AI credits. Connecting requires a ShotClick account on the Studio plan, which includes the MCP connector.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28e5a079c81919a66c838.longDescriptionZh:
ShotClick 是一个剧本编辑器：专业格式化、锁定场景编号、修订通道、制作细目以及 .fdx 导入和导出。

该插件让 ChatGPT 在脚本本身内部工作，而不是返回松散的文本。它读取您的项目、场景、主题、处理、大纲、人物、研究笔记和评论，并写回格式正确的场景、梗概、处理和大纲节拍。您的现有权限适用：在共享项目上，查看者也通过插件保持只读状态。

它可以从任何场景打开“假设”分支，因此可以并行编写故事的替代版本，而无需触及原始版本。它还到达 AI Studio，即剧本到视频的管道：它查看生成的关键帧和参考图像，然后编写与其匹配的图像和视频提示。

没有任何工具可以删除任何东西——场景、项目、笔记都不能删除——也没有工具会花费人工智能积分。连接需要 Studio 计划上的 ShotClick 帐户，其中包括 MCP 连接器。

plugin_asdk_app_6a310833394081919705b0a3.originalDescription: Edit or create video by prompt
plugin_asdk_app_6a310833394081919705b0a3.productIntro: Clueso MCP 为 Chatgpt 提供了一个完整的视频制作工具箱，连接到您的 Clueso 工作区。 Clueso 将屏幕录像、幻灯片、文档或简单的提示转变为成品视频和分步书面指南；这个连接器将所有内容都放在聊天中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a310833394081919705b0a3.productIntroEn: The Clueso MCP gives Chatgpt a complete video production toolbox, connected to your Clueso workspace. Clueso turns screen recordings, slide decks, documents, or a plain prompt into finished videos and step-by-step written guides; this connector puts all of it in the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a310833394081919705b0a3.longDescription:
The Clueso MCP gives Chatgpt a complete video production toolbox, connected to your Clueso workspace. Clueso turns screen recordings, slide decks, documents, or a plain prompt into finished videos and step-by-step written guides; this connector puts all of it in the chat.

What Chatgpt can do with it:
• Create - build a project from a prompt, a screen recording, a slide deck, or a document
• Compose - place text, callouts, shapes, images, motion graphics and stock footage across a timeline
• Narrate - write scripts and generate voiceover from a library of 350+ voices, synced to on-screen action
• Edit - make targeted changes to any clip, element or word without rebuilding the project
• Preview - render any frame as an image to check the result mid-conversation
• Publish - export the finished video, and build the written article from the same source
• Reuse - save any project as a template so the next video inherits its structure and branding

Because it runs through your assistant, it composes with whatever else you have connected pull a script from meeting notes, a feature list from a project tracker, or account detail from a CRM, and build the video from material that already exists.

Typical uses: product and feature walkthroughs, customer education libraries, internal training built from existing decks, launch and changelog videos, help-centre articles paired with video.

Everything the connector creates opens in the Clueso editor and stays fully editable.
plugin_asdk_app_6a310833394081919705b0a3.longDescriptionZh:
Clueso MCP 为 Chatgpt 提供了一个完整的视频制作工具箱，连接到您的 Clueso 工作区。 Clueso 将屏幕录像、幻灯片、文档或简单的提示转变为成品视频和分步书面指南；这个连接器将所有内容都放在聊天中。

Chatgpt 可以用它做什么：
• 创建 - 根据提示、屏幕录制、幻灯片或文档构建项目
• 撰写 - 在时间线上放置文本、标注、形状、图像、动态图形和素材素材
• 叙述 - 编写脚本并从包含 350 多个声音的库中生成画外音，并与屏幕上的动作同步
• 编辑 - 对任何剪辑、元素或单词进行有针对性的更改，而无需重建项目
• 预览 - 将任何帧渲染为图像以在对话中检查结果
• 发布 - 导出完成的视频，并从同一来源构建书面文章
• 重复使用 - 将任何项目保存为模板，以便下一个视频继承其结构和品牌

因为它通过您的助手运行，所以它可以与您连接的任何其他内容组合在一起，从会议记录中提取脚本，从项目跟踪器中提取功能列表，或从 CRM 中提取帐户详细信息，并根据现有材料构建视频。

典型用途：产品和功能演练、客户教育库、根据现有平台构建的内部培训、发布和变更日志视频、与视频配对的帮助中心文章。

连接器创建的所有内容都会在 Clueso 编辑器中打开并保持完全可编辑。

根据此帮助文档构建一个包含五个剪辑的入门视频，并为每个步骤生成一个视觉效果。
